need: Frontend fidelity and UI audit must require observable proof of the declared layout owner before a repeated-row or joined-list composition can pass. A full screenshot establishes composition context, but the audit must also bind the owning source boundary and browser-computed display, flow direction, gap, padding, separator policy, row count and overflow assertions that distinguish real flex or grid hierarchy from bare block-flow text.
negativeBoundary: Do not mandate flex for every component, turn one Dashboard Changelog measurement into universal pixel values, replace full-viewport screenshots with DOM metrics alone, or reject a different layout primitive when its approved owner and observable relationship are proven. Keep surface-shell ownership separate from row-anatomy ownership and use declared design or Grammar tokens instead of arbitrary measurements.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend visual-fidelity and UI-audit contracts reject a PASS for repeated rows when evidence contains only screenshots, text presence or component names without an observable layout-owner proof.
The proof binds the exact source owner and browser-computed display, direction, gap, padding, separator/last-row treatment, row count and document overflow that matter to the approved relationship.
Full-viewport screenshots remain mandatory for hierarchy, neighboring surfaces, scroll ownership and overlays; DOM geometry supplements rather than replaces them.
Surface shells and repeated rows retain separate owners, so a SurfaceListCard cannot hide a bare child block-flow or justify wrapping every row in a duplicate card.

Executable regression coverage proves that four text-complete Changelog rows rendered as bare block-flow cannot receive UI PASS, while the same approved meta-title-body rows with measured flex rhythm, padding and separator policy can pass.

accepts: Use the full Dashboard screenshot to judge page-level composition and a bounded computed-DOM receipt to prove the Changelog row owner.
Require separate evidence for joined surface ownership and row anatomy before UI aggregate PASS.
Treat refresh-stable geometry as continuity evidence when refresh/resume is part of the product flow.
rejects: Pass a joined history because every expected string is present while its rows remain bare block-flow.
Infer gap, padding or separator ownership from a zoomed or stitched screenshot without computed or source-bound evidence.
Repair the visual by adding duplicate nested cards when the approved contract calls for one joined surface with owned rows.
